name: Moreh
line: Moreh is a hill in the valley where Gideon camped near Midian, and the Oak of Moreh near Shechem is where Abram stopped in Canaan.

moments.title: Abram at the Oak of Moreh
moments.text: Abram traveled through Canaan as far as the Oak of Moreh at Shechem. There the LORD appeared to him and promised to give the land to his offspring, and Abram built an altar.

moments.title: Midian camps near Moreh
moments.text: Gideon and his men camped beside the spring of Harod, and the camp of Midian was north of them near the hill of Moreh. There the LORD cut Gideon's army down to three hundred men.
